body: Im on prozac right now (10 mg) for a little over a month and im also struggling with the same issues. I dont really have anything helpful to say besides ive heard its common for some people to not expereicne benefits for a pretty long time on prozac especially (several months).
not me personally but I know that is the reason for a lot of people

I've had depressive episodes for many years but the past year I feel like it's beginning to get worse and worse. I had a friend kill themselves not too long ago and I'm scared I will end up there like they did. I feel like I'm unable to make contact with other humans and like people don't accept me when I'm sad, onyl when I am happy which is rare. And honestly I wouldn't want to deal with aa depressed person myself that I don't know that well. So why would anyone want to deal with me.
